description: This file defines a class 'McpOAuthTokenStorage' for managing OAuth tokens, including storing, retrieving, and deleting tokens using VS Code's SecretStorage and global state. It also defines interfaces for OAuth token data and extended token data with server metadata.

classes.name: McpOAuthTokenStorage
classes.description: A class for securely storing and managing OAuth tokens and related metadata within a VS Code extension context.

methods.name: storeTokens
methods.description: Stores OAuth tokens and optional refresh metadata securely and updates the server list.

methods.name: getTokens
methods.description: Retrieves stored OAuth tokens without refresh metadata.

methods.name: getFullTokenData
methods.description: Retrieves full stored token data including refresh metadata for token refresh operations.

methods.name: removeTokens
methods.description: Removes stored tokens for a given server URL.

methods.name: listServers
methods.description: Lists all server URLs with stored tokens.

methods.name: addServerToList
methods.description: Adds a server URL to the list of servers with stored tokens.

methods.name: removeServerFromList
methods.description: Removes a server URL from the list of servers with stored tokens.

methods.name: hashServerUrl
methods.description: Creates a SHA-256 hash of the server URL.

methods.name: getStorageKey
methods.description: Generates a storage key based on the hashed server URL.

search-terms: token management in VS Code extension
